name: ferry
description: Tiny zero-dependency browser utility that ferries text and rich HTML onto the clipboard

scripts.build: bun run build:modules && bun run build:playground && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly && cp dist/index.d.ts dist/index.d.cts && cp dist/use-clipboard.d.ts dist/react.d.ts && cp dist/use-clipboard.d.ts dist/react.d.cts && cp dist/use-clipboard-vue.d.ts dist/vue.d.ts && cp dist/use-clipboard-vue.d.ts dist/vue.d.cts && cp dist/use-clipboard-svelte.d.ts dist/svelte.d.ts && cp dist/use-clipboard-svelte.d.ts dist/svelte.d.cts && bun scripts/fix-declarations.mjs
scripts.build:modules: bun build src/index.ts --format esm --outfile dist/index.js && bun build src/index.ts --format cjs --outfile dist/index.cjs && bun build src/use-clipboard.ts --external react --format esm --outfile dist/react.js && bun build src/use-clipboard.ts --external react --format cjs --outfile dist/react.cjs && bun build src/use-clipboard-vue.ts --external vue --format esm --outfile dist/vue.js && bun build src/use-clipboard-vue.ts --external vue --format cjs --outfile dist/vue.cjs && bun build src/use-clipboard-svelte.ts --external svelte --format esm --outfile dist/svelte.js && bun build src/use-clipboard-svelte.ts --external svelte --format cjs --outfile dist/svelte.cjs
scripts.build:playground: bun run build:cdn && bun build playground/react-demo.ts --format=iife --outfile playground/react-demo.bundle.js --target=browser --minify && bun build playground/vue-demo.ts --format=iife --outfile playground/vue-demo.bundle.js --target=browser --minify
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun test && bun run build && bun scripts/check-size.ts && bun scripts/check-package.ts
